up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are referenced in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1131436. For each such molecule, return: the molecule's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), the molecule's preferred name (compound_name, from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Only include molecules that have a non‑null canonical_smiles. Order the result set by molecule ChEMBL ID, then by preferred name, then by canonical SMILES (all ascending). Do not limit the number of rows; include every qualifying molecule. A molecule is considered referenced in the document if it appears in the compound_records table linked to that document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1131436' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
